purpose: Provides an automated AAL3 atlas-based morphometric analysis, hemispheric asymmetry, and distance-connectome pipeline for neuroimaging in 3D Slicer using N4ITK bias correction and Elastix registration.
summary: AAL3BrainLabeling is a well-structured and implemented 3D Slicer extension providing automated AAL3 atlas-based brain labeling, morphometry, asymmetry analysis, and structural distance connectomics using SlicerElastix and N4ITK. The codebase follows Slicer conventions, includes proper license and packaging, handles resource cleanup during batch processing, and presents no safety or environment concerns. 🟢 Recommend merge.

safety.rationale: No malicious code, unauthorized telemetry, unsafe deserialization, or network access. Files are written locally to user-selected or temporary directories.

environment.rationale: The extension uses Slicer's standard built-in modules (Elastix, SegmentStatistics, N4ITK Bias Field Correction) and standard scripted module structure without modifying global Python environments or side effects.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt correctly configures the scripted module and installs all required python scripts and resource files (atlas, template, color table, labels).

license.rationale: Includes an explicit MIT License with correct copyright and terms permitting distribution.

soundness.rationale: Follows ScriptedLoadableModule design patterns, handles batch processing with scene node cleanup, manages errors cleanly, and relies on standard Slicer APIs.

utility.rationale: Provides comprehensive documentation, methodology explanations, sample resources/atlas data, and useful neuroimaging features.

not_checked: Full 3D Slicer runtime environment execution and GUI widget interaction (beyond code inspection)
